TICKET
# $urls in SitemapController are overwritten by global variables

In https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/29797/files I added a possibility to edit frontend sitemap and add new groups of links to it. Also, it passes the data into front office in a new way, in `$urls` variable. But this variable collides with `$urls` assigned in `FrontController`.

You don't notice it doesn't work because a theme was not adapted yet, I went to do it now and found the bug.

## Attendu
Variable name must be changed from `$urls` to `$sitemapUrls` for example.
Theme PRs must be done and merged ASAP, before the release.

## Étapes
`{dump($urls)}` in `/themes/theme/templates/cms/sitemap.tpl`
